name: print-social-dark-digital-marketing-expert-post-with-ringed-circle-photos
title: Charcoal 'We Are Digital Marketing Expert' post with two circle photos linked by orbit lines
whatItIs: A square charcoal post with two overlapping circle photos (a woman at a laptop, a team of three) wrapped in white arcs dotted with small circles, a white headline with yellow 'Marketing Expert', a yellow 'Join now' button and contact details.
whatItMeans: Clean and connected; orbit lines link individual and team.
techniques: Overlap two circle photos to show individual and team.
Wrap photos in orbit arcs with dot nodes.
Use yellow only for key words and the button.

vocabulary.definition: A curved line circling an element with dot nodes.
Layering one element partly over another.
